description: No charge. Turns a genre preset, an art-style preset and a one-line idea into a short game spec your coding agent can build from: intent (frozen), plan (milestones with testable done_when, playtest, asset manifest) and state (you update it with update_state). Returns game_spec.json plus GAME_SPEC.md, AGENTS.md and PROMPT.md to save in the project. Names of existing games, characters and brands are removed: specs are original games only. With an API key the spec is saved (specId) for get_spec, update_state and asset_kit.

genre.description: obby | simulator (also tycoon) | survivors (horde) | cozy (one-verb 3D toy) | rpg | voxel (city builder) | coop (two players)

idea.description: One sentence in your own words. No "like <existing game>".

target.description: roblox, or web (a single-page three.js game)

name: game_concept
title: Write a game spec from an idea
